146.81039,-35.32196.name: DIR 164 — Canola (Brassica napus L.) field trial (site 1), Lockhart Shire Council
146.81039,-35.32196.type: Canola (Brassica napus L.), licensed field trial
146.81039,-35.32196.desc: WHAT. A licensed GMO crop field trial site, Herbicide tolerance, held by Monsanto Australia Limited. WHERE IT SITS. OGTR named the council area this site is in and published no coordinate on the page this was read from, so this marker sits in that council area and not at the trial itself. WHY IT MATTERS. OGTR names the council area of every licensed site, its area in hectares and the licence it runs under. No other register on this map states where a release is at all, which is the comparison worth making even at this resolution.
